features.title: Eminent Comfort Design
features.text: Crafted with a high, recron-filled, engulfing backrest, Eminent gently cradles your back and shoulders, creating a cocooned seating experience that feels supportive, relaxed, and reassuringly comfortable.

features.title: Quiet Sophistication
features.text: Smooth synthetic leather upholstery gives your sofa a polished, contemporary appearance, while the wooden facia adds a warm, aesthetic accent that enhances visual depth and elevates your living space.

features.title: Pocket Spring Seat
features.text: Pocket springs embedded within the seat add a soft, buoyant feel, giving you subtle bounce and lasting comfort without compromising on everyday seating support.

features.title: Ergonomic Armrests
features.text: Angular, padded armrests are shaped to support your arms in a natural posture, letting you rest comfortably while maintaining a relaxed, well-aligned seating position.

features.title: Built for Longevity
features.text: A solid pine wood frame paired with durable plywood construction and neat, symmetrical stitching ensures your sofa feels sturdy, reliable, and refined over time.

features.title: Ample Ground Clearance
features.text: Sturdy PVC legs lift the sofa off the floor, giving the sofa reliable support while creating practical ground clearance that makes everyday floor cleaning effortless.
